Meta.title: {brand}: receptionist robots for Bali lobbies
Meta.description: Bali Editions of Snow and Timo plus the Bali-built Taksu Kiosk: they greet with Om Swastiastu, show Aksara Bali per Pergub 80/2018, print tickets and visitor passes, and hold a spoken conversation.

hero.title: Receptionists that welcome guests with Om Swastiastu
hero.body: Snow and Timo Bali Edition in traditional dress, plus our own Taksu Kiosk. All of them show Aksara Bali, print tickets and visitor passes, and talk with guests in Indonesian or English.
hero.imageAlt: Snow and Timo Bali Edition in Balinese traditional dress

lineup.title: Choose your receptionist
lineup.intro: Two mobile robots we modify for Bali, and one static kiosk we build ourselves.

showcase.title: One app on all three
showcase.intro: Snow, Timo, and Taksu Kiosk run the same kiosk app, which we build ourselves. Pick a service to see its screen.
showcase.note: Screens from the Timo demo at a public service office. The venue data is sample data.

home.title: Main menu
home.body: Guests are greeted, then pick a service with one touch. The menu, counters, and content are set up for your venue.
home.alt: Main menu on Timo’s screen: talk, take a queue number, guest book, and directions

voice.title: Conversation
voice.body: Guests ask by voice or by typing. Speech is processed on your own server, and answers come only from your venue’s data.
voice.alt: A conversation with Timo about what is needed for an ID card

queue.title: Queue
queue.body: A queue number in Balinese numerals, an estimated wait, and a QR to follow your turn, printed on the spot.
queue.alt: Queue ticket A-001 with Balinese numerals and a QR code

guestbook.title: Guest book
guestbook.body: Visitors register on screen, and a pass with their name in Aksara Bali and a QR prints straight away.
guestbook.alt: Visitor pass for Ni Luh Putu Sari with her name in Aksara Bali

route.title: Directions
route.body: A route on the floor plan with spoken steps. Snow and Timo can walk guests there, and Taksu Kiosk prints a route slip.
route.alt: Office floor plan with the route to Counter B

aksara.title: Name in Aksara Bali
aksara.body: Guests type their name, and the kiosk writes it in Aksara Bali and prints it as a keepsake.
aksara.alt: The name Wayan Sukarta in Aksara Bali on screen and on a printout

aksara.title: Aksara Bali on every screen and printout
aksara.intro: Our kiosks write venue names in Aksara Bali above the Latin script, following Bali’s signage rules.

bali.title: Knows the Balinese calendar
bali.intro: The robot’s greetings and notices follow the holy days of the Pawukon calendar.
bali.nextHoly: {name} in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

useCases.title: Where our robots work
useCases.intro: Every venue moves guests differently. We tailor the content and the robot.

process.title: How we install
process.intro: From the site survey to a robot at work in your lobby.
